Name: RB's Sebastian Portraits
Author: rinkobunny
Description:
[size=3][center]Portrait mod for Sebastian featuring 11 of his portraits redrawn by me!!

[b]Edit: [/b]I changed the files about a million times as I didn't notice my art program corrupted them (curse you clip studio) and made some of the sprites funky, specifically the very last one. And then I uploaded the wrong files a bunch of times after. The right ones should be in now but if there's any problems let me know.

Hello everyone!!!!!! This is my first mod I've made for... well... ANYTHING especially Stardew lol for now these are some base game portraits for Sebastian! I may or may not make a seasonal outfit version and his Halloween costume for SDVE (leaning towards doing them sometime this weekend but they take forever...) I I know definitely prefer having one big portrait mod for all the characters rather than one for one character so I'm thinking about making a mod for all of them including SDVE. Installation guide and requirements are down below!! If you have any issues or questions please let me know! Thank you and please enjoy!!

[font=Verdana]
[/font][/center][/size][font=Verdana][size=6][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size][/font]
[size=4]Requires SMAPI to run mods and Portraiture for adding the portraits in game.[/size]


[font=Verdana][size=6][u][b]Installation Guide[/b][/u][/size][/font][size=3]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Make sure you have Portraiture installed! You can find the file in the Requirements tab![/size]
[*][size=3]Download either Version 1 (RB_Sebastian) for NO PIERCINGS or Ver 2 (RB_Sebastian_V2) for PIERCINGS (Septum & snake bites) from the files tab. [u]ONLY DOWNLOAD BOTH IF YOU WANT BOTH IN YOUR GAME!![/u] You should be able to download both without any conflicts and press the P menu in game to switch versions in Portraiture!!![/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the file, select the versions you want (Version 1, 2, or Both), right click, and select "Copy".[/size]
[*][size=3]Find your mods folder (if you don't know how, click on This PC > Windows (C:) > Program Files (either Program Files or Program Files 86x) > Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > Mods)[/size]
[*][size=3]Find the Portraiture folder in your Mods folder. Then, open the folder, and open the "Portraits" folder inside it. The path should look like Mods > Portraiture > Portraits.[/size]
[*][size=3]Right click, and "Paste" both folders into the Portraits folder. You should have RB_Sebastian or RB_Sebastian_V2, or both if you picked both, now in the Portraits folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]That's it! Hopefully you did it right, and now when you open your game you should see the portraits! Have fun![/size]
[/list][size=3][b]P.S. I drew these on a relatively large canvas (1024 x 1024) So if dialogue loads slowly that should be why. Feel free to size down the images or compress them yourself if it significantly impacts your game.[/b][/size]


[size=3]Hope y'all enjoy! I have absolutely 0 coding knowledge so if any issues occur I don't know if I'll be able to help, but if you encounter any problems it should be with Portraiture and not the portraits themselves. Let me know if you need any help or have any questions at all, I'll be happy to answer![/size][b][size=3]
[color=#ff0000]*Note: Feel free to edit the portrait files, I don't care. Just please do not claim the artwork as your own or publish it.*[/color][/size][/b]

Downloads.Description: W/ Piercings. Can be used with Ver 1  or switched interchangeably.
